item.title: Baby Jam at the Library: Lap Songs for Babies Up to 24 Months
item.description: The Jamestown Philomenian Library's Tuesday lap-sit session brings stories, finger rhymes and small-instrument songs to the youngest island families.

item.title: Arts Center Sets Winter Lineup, Starting With Nov. 20 Show
item.description: Molly Kugler Dickinson’s “Of Longing and Loss” runs Nov. 20 through Jan. 9, followed by a ceramics show in late winter.

item.title: Today on the Island: Galleries, Skills and Jazz Tonight
item.description: Two gallery viewings open at 10:00 AM, a Veterans Day skills session runs at Fort Getty, and RI Jazz Collective plays at 6:00 PM.

item.title: Electric Bills Could Drop Up to 75% Under New Rhode Island Energy Discount
item.description: Five income-based discount levels from 10% to 75% replace the current 25% and 30% discounts, starting in early 2027.

item.title: Knitting and Mysteries at the Library on Nov. 23
item.description: Needles Galore and the Monday Mysteries book group both meet at the Jamestown Philomenian Library on the fourth Monday of the month.

item.title: The Historical Society's Vault Opens Tuesdays and Thursdays
item.description: The Jamestown Historical Society's research vault welcomes visitors on weekday mornings, and a monthly foyer exhibit shows rarely seen objects.

item.title: After-School Wheel Throwing for Grades 3 to 6
item.description: A Nov. 16–25 Arts After School session teaches the basics of wheel throwing, and a mixed-media series follows.

item.title: Young Artists Get Winter Projects at the Arts Center
item.description: Step One watercolor on Dec. 5 and a Second Saturday sculpting class on Dec. 12 are open to young children.

item.title: Holiday Cooking Classes at the Arts Center in December
item.description: Pad Thai, holiday appetizers and sides, and a soup-and-bread class fill the December culinary calendar.

item.title: St. Matthew's Piano Concerts Have Played Since 2001
item.description: The Jamestown Community Piano Association has presented more than eighty concerts at Saint Matthew's Episcopal Church since its first in November 2001.

item.title: Out of the Box's Artists-in-Residence Show Runs to Dec. 31
item.description: More than 30 artists in residence share one collaborative show at the studio and gallery on Clinton Avenue, open from Aug. 8 through Dec. 31.

item.title: Members' Show Opens, Plus a Crash Course in Art Law
item.description: The Jamestown Arts Center opens its annual members' exhibition Nov. 20 and hosts an artists' rights session Dec. 6.

item.title: New Portrait Show Opens at the Arts Center Nov. 12
item.description: Viktoria Lubchenko's Portraits of Unspoken Truth fills the Arts Center gallery from Nov. 12 through Dec. 12.

item.title: Make a Ceramic Ornament at the Arts Center on Dec. 7
item.description: A drop-in decorating evening runs from 6 to 9 p.m. on Monday, Dec. 7, for $15.

item.title: Thanksgiving and Friendsgiving Classes at the Arts Center
item.description: Three November cooking classes run from Monday, Nov. 9 through Nov. 23, with member prices listed alongside.

item.title: Recycled Robots: A Second Saturday Workshop for Grades 1–5
item.description: Kids in grades 1 through 5 can join the Arts Center's Nov. 14 session, at $15 per child or $12 for members.

item.title: Final Colonial Dinner Reimagined at the Yacht Club, Nov. 14
item.description: The Jamestown Historical Society's last reimagined Colonial Dinner runs Saturday, Nov. 14, with a buffet, cash bar and clam chowder.

item.title: Get the Jamestown Island News App
item.description: Put Jamestown Island News on your phone's home screen or your computer's desktop and open it with one tap, like any other app.

item.title: This Weekend in Jamestown: Live Music, a Teddy Bear Clinic and Italian Wannabe
item.description: Three nights of music at the Narragansett Cafe, a Saturday film screening at the Arts Center, and the last day of Imprint and Playback, Nov. 6 to 8.

item.title: Tuesday Movies at the Library: Rocky and Top Gun
item.description: Anniversary screenings of Rocky on Nov. 10 and Top Gun on Nov. 17 run from 1:30 to 4 p.m. in the library's Meeting Hall.

item.title: Open Mic Night at the Narragansett Cafe on Nov. 18
item.description: Musicians and listeners gather at the cafe on Wednesday evening, Nov. 18, from 6:30 to 10 p.m.

item.title: Send a Thank-You by Postcard at the Library on Nov. 14
item.description: A Saturday morning workshop invites adults to decorate a postcard for someone in town they are grateful for.

item.title: Jamestown Election: Quinn Leads Council Vote, Final Seat Separated by 36 Votes, Housing Bond Approved
item.description: Reveron stands 36 votes ahead of Glackin for the fifth council seat, and voters approve borrowing up to $3 million for affordable housing, in unofficial results.

item.title: Tree Lighting and Concert Dec. 5 Caps the Holiday Stroll
item.description: The island lights its Christmas tree at East Ferry Wharf from 5:30 to 7 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 5, after a full day of the Holiday Stroll and Santa's arrival by boat.

item.title: Santa and Mrs. Claus to Arrive by Sea for Jamestown's Village Holiday Stroll
item.description: The Coastal Queen docks at East Ferry Wharf at 1 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 5. A fire truck carries Santa and Mrs. Claus up to the Conanicut Gift Shop for photos from 1 to 2 p.m.

item.title: November at the Narragansett Cafe: A Band Almost Every Night
item.description: The Senders, 3 Wheelin, Deep End, the Strumdawgs, Jury Band and Don't Think Twice lead a packed month at 25 Narragansett Ave.

item.title: Jamestown Community Chorus Sings 'A Contemporary Christmas'
item.description: Two December concerts at the Recreation Center, Dec. 12 at 4 p.m. and Dec. 13 at 3 p.m., with mostly 21st-century music.

item.title: The Everybody Chorus Is Rockin' the '70s. Anyone Can Join
item.description: No auditions, all ages, Saturday mornings at the Recreation Center, and the money for music books goes to charity.

item.title: Holiday Cruises from Jamestown: Mrs. Claus, Carolers and the Bay at Christmas
item.description: The Coastal Queen runs a Candy Cane Express with Mrs. Claus on Nov. 29 and a caroling cruise right after Santa docks on Dec. 5, with more carol sailings from Newport on Dec. 13 and 20.

item.title: Off-Season on the Island: Ferry's Done, Here's What's Open
item.description: The Jamestown Newport Ferry and the town's museum and windmill closed for the season Oct. 12. Here's what's open and how fall cleanup works.
